question: Must this external PR provide live installed-binding and real-channel routed-delivery proof, or should the mocked race proof receive an explicit override?
rationale: The implementation and regression test support the invariant, but only a maintainer can accept the residual integration uncertainty in place of the repository's normal external-PR real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Require live routed proof
options.body: Ask for redacted output from an installed plugin binding using an actual channel route, with cancellation during the route and no fallback delivery.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the deterministic race test and QA entry-path evidence as sufficient for this timing-dependent internal invariant.

recommendation.title: Require live routed proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted output from an installed plugin binding using an actual channel route, with cancellation during the route and no fallback delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the introduction and subsequent maintenance of the conversation-binding and abort-aware routed-delivery path.
